candidates.name: Leases: when to register (PG25) collection
verified_facts: Updated 1 June 2026.
Covers compulsory and voluntary registration of leasehold estates and how leases are noted or registered.
semantic_limits: Lease registration status is legal/title metadata and is not parcel terrain evidence.

candidates.name: Practice guide 25: leases - when to register
verified_facts: Updated 1 June 2026.
Separates compulsory registration, voluntary registration, non-registerable leases, noting of leases and application procedure.
semantic_limits: Lease registration procedure does not establish exact floor-level geometry or ground elevation.

candidates.name: Leases: determination (PG26) collection
verified_facts: Updated 6 July 2026.
Explains situations in which leases are determined and the effect on registered titles.
semantic_limits: Lease termination status is title lifecycle evidence only.

candidates.name: Practice guide 26: leases - determination
verified_facts: Updated 6 July 2026.
Lists merger, surrender, disclaimer, effluxion, forfeiture, court order, notice, frustration and enlargement as routes by which leases may determine.
semantic_limits: A determined lease may change title state but does not change measured terrain values.

candidates.name: Practice guide 27: leasehold reform legislation
verified_facts: Updated 1 June 2026.
Covers leasehold reform legislation including enfranchisement and lease extensions.
semantic_limits: Leasehold reform changes legal estate interests, not bare-earth elevation.

candidates.name: Easements (PG62) collection
verified_facts: Updated 1 June 2026.
Provides guidance on registration of easements under the Land Registration Act 2002.
semantic_limits: Easement registration is legal-interest metadata, not terrain height.

candidates.name: Practice guide 62: easements
verified_facts: Updated 1 June 2026.
Deeds usually need plans showing dominant and servient land.
Plans must satisfy HMLR plan requirements and be signed by the grantor where required.
semantic_limits: An easement plan is not substituted for the parcel polygon used for terrain sampling.

candidates.name: Guidance for preparing plans for HM Land Registry applications
verified_facts: Updated 13 October 2025.
Plans must allow land to be clearly identified on Ordnance Survey mapping.
For transfers or leases of part, a plan is usually required and e-lodged plans must remain legible and sufficiently detailed.
semantic_limits: Application-plan acceptability does not imply exact legal-boundary or elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (PG40s5) collection
verified_facts: Updated 13 July 2026.
Title plan must be viewed with the register and referenced documents.
Update history records changes to title-plan guidance.
semantic_limits: Collection freshness is lineage evidence, not numeric terrain evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Overview
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 is a 5 m DTM created with protruding features removed.
The product is maintained on a 3-to-5-year flying programme and updated quarterly.
Accuracy is assessed as RMSE against GPS points across geographic classes.
semantic_limits: Terrain 5 remains a secondary cross-check for this sub-metre parcel workflow.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 documentation hub
verified_facts: OS identifies Terrain 5 as a five-metre grid/contour DTM of Great Britain.
The product is updated quarterly.
semantic_limits: Documentation authority does not itself prove parcel-specific acquisition date or accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Technical Specification root
verified_facts: GML features and geometries use unique identifiers for a given release.
Updates are whole-tile refreshes rather than feature-based change-only updates.
The GML CRS is expressed as EPSG:27700.
semantic_limits: Release identifiers and CRS metadata do not change underlying terrain accuracy.

candidates.name: About the Defra Data Services Platform
verified_facts: DSP provides APIs, survey-data access, support and applications.
Survey access includes LiDAR and aerial-photography data.
semantic_limits: Platform availability is service-discovery evidence, not terrain measurement.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - opening and using downloaded LiDAR files
verified_facts: Downloaded LiDAR is a technical dataset intended for GIS software.
Preview is suitable for viewing imagery, while analysis requires the downloaded data.
semantic_limits: A viewer or rendered preview is not a substitute for reproducible raster sampling.

candidates.name: OGC API - Tiles - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: Approved OGC standard for serving tiled spatially referenced data or maps.
Supports multiple tiled data forms, not only rendered maps.
Tile matrix sets partition/index space at defined scales in a CRS.
semantic_limits: Tile retrieval alone does not establish that a tile contains native numeric elevation.

candidates.name: TMS 2.0 Release Notes
verified_facts: The document is explicitly release notes, not an OGC Standard.
It records corrections including axis-order confusion and encoding inconsistencies for TMS 2.0.
semantic_limits: Release notes may guide compatibility checks but are not treated as normative requirements.

candidates.name: OGC API - EDR 1.0
verified_facts: Version 1.0.0 is an approved OGC standard.
EDR defines discovery and query requirements for spatiotemporal data resources.
semantic_limits: Version 1.0 is retained only for version-lineage checks where 1.1 is the newer approved standard.

candidates.name: OGC CDB Version 2 - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: Approved OGC standard published 6 January 2026.
Its abstract coverage module requires CRS consistency and minimum metadata.
Coverage content is conceptually independent of a particular access service.
semantic_limits: CDB coverage architecture is interoperability evidence, not an elevation source for this slot.

candidates.name: GeoPackage Tiled Gridded Coverage r1
verified_facts: Defines 16-bit PNG and 32-bit TIFF encodings for regular gridded coverage values such as elevation.
The extension requires explicit coverage/domain/range metadata.
semantic_limits: Older revision is retained for version-lineage checks; current implementation guidance should prefer the newer revision.

candidates.name: GeoPackage Encoding Standard 1.3.1
verified_facts: GeoPackage is a self-describing SQLite geospatial container.
Tile matrix metadata includes real-world pixel size in the SRS units.
Zoom levels can change pixel size and are not inherently native source resolution.
semantic_limits: GeoPackage tile pixel size and zoom metadata must not be mistaken for source vertical accuracy.
